+  # map literal body := ε | (Id ':' expr) (',' Id ':' expr)*  — each pair a `Label`,
+  # so map fields reuse the labeled-construction machinery (expand/subst, lowering).
+  def parse_map_expr(ts Vec(Tok)) Args
+  def parse_map_expr([TRBrace | rest]) := AP([], rest)
+  def parse_map_expr([TId(k), TOp(":") | rest])
+    case parse_bp(0, rest) do
+      P(v, [TComma | r2]) ->
+        case parse_map_expr(skip_nl(r2)) do
+          AP(more, r) -> AP([Label(k, v) | more], r)
+        end
+      P(v, [TRBrace | r2]) -> AP([Label(k, v)], r2)
+      P(v, rest2) -> AP([Label(k, v)], rest2)
+    end
+  end
+
   # postfix := '.' field (field access) | '(' args ')' (call), repeated
   def parse_postfix(node Expr, ts Vec(Tok)) Parse
   def parse_postfix(node, [TOp("."), TId(field) | rest]) := parse_postfix(Dot(node, field), rest)
